title: Cloudflare R2 for a server-readable session archive needs your account; the E: copy is done

owner_note.text: The August and September session pictures are archived on the Passport drive (651 MB down to 169 MB on disk; nothing deleted from git). The storage design (core/Page/doc/storage.md) keeps R2 as the server-readable second copy with a pointer left behind in each archived page; that needs a Cloudflare R2 bucket and an API token from your account (about ten minutes on your side), after which a task can push the archive and wire the "open the full log" fetch. Until then the archive is local-only, which you said is acceptable.
